name: Heping-7-Hold-View-From-Entrance
visual_desc: ROOM SIZE: converted freighter cargo hold ops bay ~8×5 m, 2.6 m ceiling, steel deck plates, bare metal bulkheads with stiffener ribs and rust blooms. NORTH WALL (entrance): heavy watertight hatch center open, cable trunking above, life-vest locker right of hatch, extinguisher left. SOUTH WALL (opposite): dual large monitors on bolted rack showing dark strait maps dense with green swarm dots, fold-out metal desk, simple folding chair, clipboard zone, noodle container zone, secondary small status screen. EAST WALL (right when entering): row of black 19-inch server racks with blinking LEDs, cold-aisle ~1 m gap, cable ladders overhead, floor cable trays. WEST WALL (left when entering): more server racks and UPS cabinets, printed logistics binders on a crate seat for Guo, coiled fiber spools. CENTER: narrow clear walk ~1 m between racks to desk, empty of people. CEILING/FLOOR: exposed cable trays, fluorescent battens cold white + green monitor spill; scuffed anti-slip steel floor. SHOW EMPTY WITHOUT PEOPLE. Photoreal cramped utilitarian night-shift tech hold, portrait-wide from entrance. Converted freighter cargo hold used as swarm ops bay: rows of live server racks with blinking LEDs and audible fan roar; open cable runs along bare metal bulkheads with stiffener ribs and rust blooms; cold fluorescent light mixed with monitor glow and rack indicator colors; narrow ~1 m aisles; utilitarian temporary feel; Chen’s folding chair, large swarm-map console, paper checklist, pencil, plastic beef-noodle container with cooled broth; Guo seated adjacent with paper logistics printout stack; possible slight ship roll/vibration.

anchor_points.axes: X=[0,1] image-left-to-right wall. Y=[0,1] entrance-to-far-wall. Z=[0,1] floor-to-ceiling. View-To-Entrance: x_mirrored = 1 - x (left↔right swap), Y depth reversed. View-From-Left-Wall (x≈0): lateral=Y, depth=X. View-From-Right-Wall (x≈1): lateral=1-Y, depth=1-X. View-Center-To-Far: same as From-Entrance. View-Center-To-Entrance: same as To-Entrance. View-By-Far-Wall (y≈0.85): same as From-Entrance. View-By-Entrance (y≈0.15): same as To-Entrance.

zones.label: Entrance hatch zone
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Open watertight hatch centered on entrance wall; extinguisher image-left of hatch; life-vest locker image-right of hatch; cable trunking above. Narrow aisle mouth beyond threshold between left and right rack ends. DEPTH: entrance hatch threshold → aisle mouth → rack rows mid-ground → far desk and monitors background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Hatch and entrance wall in far background center; aisle runs toward camera from background; rack ends frame the path. Extinguisher at x_mirrored≈0.7 (image-right in this view); life-vest locker at x_mirrored≈0.28 (image-left in this view). DEPTH: center aisle foreground → rack corridor mid-ground → open hatch entrance wall background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_lateral: From image-left wall: entrance hatch appears toward entrance-side edge of frame; life-vest locker and image-right wall deeper along X; aisle runs entrance-to-far beside camera. DEPTH along X: image-left wall behind camera → aisle → image-right racks background.

zones.label: Narrow center walk aisle
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Clear ~1 m walk centered (x≈0.5) between image-left server racks and image-right server racks; floor cable trays along aisle; overhead cable ladders and fluorescent battens above. DEPTH: entrance threshold → aisle mid-ground between rack faces → fold-out desk and swarm monitors far background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Aisle mid-ground center; far-wall desk/monitors nearest behind camera; rack faces on both sides (image-left racks now at x_mirrored≈0.88 frame-right; image-right racks at x_mirrored≈0.12 frame-left). DEPTH: desk-side aisle foreground → rack corridor mid-ground → entrance hatch background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_lateral: From image-left wall looking across: aisle is mid-depth along X; entrance-side toward one frame edge, far-desk toward the other; image-right racks are far background wall. DEPTH: image-left rack face → center aisle → image-right rack row background.
